# ui::NativeControlDesc

Header: `winui/render/NativeHost.hpp`.

The Win32 child window a [NativeControl](../controls/native-control.md#uinativecontrol) creates: a window class name, its initial text and style bits. Windows only. Without a native host (a headless window, another platform) nothing is created, and the control keeps its size and draws nothing. The style fields are plain integers so this header compiles on any platform. On Windows, pass WS_*, WS_EX_* and control style values as they are.

Example: 
```cpp
auto stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
ui::NativeControlDesc desc{
    .class_name   = "EDIT",
    .initial_text = "hello",
    .style        = 0x0004 /*ES_MULTILINE*/ | 0x00200000 /*WS_VSCROLL*/,
};
stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::NativeControl>(std::move(desc), ui::Size{200.0f, 80.0f}));
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class_name` | `std::string` |  | Registered window class, e.g. "RICHEDIT50W" or "EDIT". |
| `initial_text` | `std::string` |  | The window text at creation (initial content). |
| `style` | `std::uint32_t` | `0` | Extra WS_* / control style bits (the host adds WS_CHILD). |
| `ex_style` | `std::uint32_t` | `0` | WS_EX_* bits. |
